# dokploy_bootstrap (Resource)

Bootstraps a fresh Dokploy instance by creating an admin user and API key. This resource should only be used once per Dokploy instance to perform initial setup. The generated api_key can then be used to configure the provider for other resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address for the admin user.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the admin user.
- `host` (String) The Dokploy server URL (e.g., http://localhost:3000). Required for bootstrap since provider may not be configured yet.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the admin user.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the admin user (min 8 characters, no special characters that need escaping).

### Optional

- `api_key_name` (String) Name for the generated API key.

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The generated API key. Use this to configure the Dokploy provider.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (user ID).
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the created admin user.
